subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 2 – Lesson 3: Vocabulary and Grammar (Where’s the pencil?)
outcomes: I can name shelf, computer, cupboard, desk, chair and table.
I can ask Where's the pencil? and say It's in / on / under the desk.
I can read short oo words like book and cook, and the word why.

tf.s: It's under the chair. means it is below the chair.
A pencil in the pencil case is inside it.
A book on the shelf is under the shelf.
tf.why: on means on top of the shelf.

tf.s: We ask Where's the ...? to find a thing.
tf.why: Yes! Where asks about the place.

tf.s: The oo in book is short /ʊ/.
tf.why: Well done! b - oo - k has short oo.

tf.s: c - oo - k makes the word cook.
tf.why: Yes! c - oo - k is cook.

tf.s: Why is a word for a place.
tf.why: Why asks for a reason: Why is he sad?

tf.s: Where's the ruler? It's red. is a good answer.
tf.why: Where asks the place: It's in the cupboard.

tf.s: The word foot has ng in it.
tf.why: foot has oo: f - oo - t.

boxes.q: The pencil is inside the box. It's ... the box.
The book is on top of the desk. It's ... the desk.
The bag is below the table. It's ... the table.

boxes.why: f - oo - t has short oo.

mcq.why: h - oo - k has short oo.

mcq.q: Which question asks about a place?
The ball is below the chair. Where's the ball?
The ruler is inside the cupboard. You say...
A book is under a chair. Make the question.
The book is in / on the shelf. Which is right?
Which group has only short oo words?
mcq.why: book, look and cook all have short oo.

mcq.q: Which is the odd one out?
mcq.why: A pencil is small. Desk, chair and shelf are furniture.
